When we discussed this a while ago one idea was to have nuts, bfgs, nesterov, etc be separate commands and then sample and optimize would alias to whatever we wanted the default to be.  This would make some things easier since, for instance, bfgs and nesterov will take a completely different set of parameters.  Or rather, they would if it was possible.  BFGS doesn't have much in the way of user visible options right now, but I would like to change that if it wouldn't pollute the overall options space.

I like the var=val convention as I think it's clearer.

I think it also makes sense to have some global options as well.  E.G., data and init, although maybe it's just best to reimplement them for each subcommand in case we need to do specialization like an init for an ensemble sampler.

Cheers,
Marcus
